messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>

 "brief": "## Problem\nUsers are unable to complete tasks because critical system functions, like pulling supplier reports, are blocked. This delays workflows and prevents progress until the underlying issue is resolved.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Two accounts have reported this issue via support channels [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].\n- The affected accounts are Marrowgate Commercial and Quillon Business Insurance [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].\n\n## Evidence\n- A user from Marrowgate Commercial reported, \"Hi Bryn, I’m having trouble pulling the latest supplier reports into the system — any idea what might be blocking it?\" [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8].\n- A user from Quillon Business Insurance stated, \"Appreciate it — we’re blocked until this is sorted. Let me know if you need access logs or role examples.\" [i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].\n- There have been 2 total mentions of this problem [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].\n- These mentions have come from 1 route: support [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].\n- The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from the two affected accounts is £2,460,000.0 [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].\n- Marrowgate Commercial has an ARR of £1,600,000.0 and Quillon Business Insurance has an ARR of £860,000.0 [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].\n\n## Why now\n- The issue was first reported on 2026-09-29 [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8] and was still unresolved as of 2026-10-21 [i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].\n- Two accounts are due for renewal in the next 90 days [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad]. Marrowgate Commercial renews on 2026-12-12 and Quillon Business Insurance renews on 2027-01-20 [i:9cc8b7610882f5a8][i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].\n- The unresolved blocking issue is actively preventing workflow progress for these key accounts as they approach renewal [i:fb0d21ed9ccf5dad].",
 "cited_insights": [
